ranking: Existing mean within-setting ranks across twelve equally weighted settings; unchanged
test_estimand: Mean relative error to unreconciled base: ratio of mean losses within each setting, averaged equally over six settings per dataset and then over two fixed datasets. WAPE uses all-node MAE; sMASE uses train-scaled absolute errors. Base denominators are recomputed in each bootstrap sample.
resampling: Non-circular moving blocks, shared indices across all methods, both bases and all three leads within each dataset; independent resampling across the two fixed datasets. Fitted seeds are averaged, not resampled.
test: Two-sided empirical centered-bootstrap test of zero difference in mean relative error. Center each bootstrap difference at its bootstrap mean; include the observed sample in the Monte Carlo correction (1 + extreme)/(B + 1). Approximate finite-sample calibration.
multiplicity: Holm jointly across 171 method pairs times two metrics (342 hypotheses), separately for each block specification
display: CD-style mean-rank axis; bars show maximal contiguous groups for which every internal pair is not rejected. Absence of a shared bar alone is not a significance decision. No Nemenyi critical-difference threshold.
scope: Conditional temporal inference for this fixed two-dataset benchmark and already fitted models; no population-of-datasets claim, retraining, selection or replacement of original DM-Holm results
